senses.zh_definition: 汽车人；《变形金刚》系列中通常由擎天柱领导的机器人阵营，亦指该阵营的一名成员。
senses.en_definition: A member of the usually heroic robot faction in the Transformers franchise, typically led by Optimus Prime.
senses.ms_definition: Anggota puak robot dalam francais Transformers yang lazimnya dipimpin oleh Optimus Prime dan menentang Decepticon.
senses.nuances: 专名通常写作 Autobot。资料包未提供 DBP 释义；此处马来语释义为编写释义，official 字段依指定格式保留，不表示 DBP 已认证其为普通词。不能仅凭拼写将其解释成自动聊天机器人。角色归属依据：[Hasbro：Transformers Earth Wars](https://transformersearthwars.hasbro.com/)。

etymology.historical_story: Autobot belongs to the fictional vocabulary of Transformers. Hasbro presents the Autobots as the heroic faction associated with Optimus Prime, opposing the Decepticons. Malay speakers encountering the name in films, games, or toy descriptions can retain it as a proper name. Its fictional affiliation matters more than attempting to derive it through ordinary Malay affixes. [Hasbro](https://transformersearthwars.hasbro.com/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 用“会变汽车的机器人”记住 Autobot 的作品形象；这是记忆画面，不是马来语构词分析。
